title: Register the django-drf-react recipe and validate registry entries
requirements: Add a second entry to registry/recipes.json with id django-drf-react, version 0.1.0, status conformant, composes the stack (stack-django-drf, frontend-react, db-postgres, storage-s3, provider-yandex, qa-browser), requires ["web", "django", "react", "postgres", "object-storage"], regions ["ru"], excludes ["mobile", "regulated"], template django-drf-react.

Extend src/forgel/registry.py with a deterministic validation function that rejects: duplicate ids, malformed composes entries (missing '@'), non-numeric versions, a conformant recipe whose template directory does not exist under src/forgel/templates/, and unknown status values; the loader calls it and raises RegistryError.
Keep select_recipe behavior unchanged for existing callers: requirements still filter by requires, excludes, status and region.

Extend tests/test_registry.py to cover: the recipe is selectable for requirements {requires: [web, django, react, postgres, object-storage], region: ru}, is not selected for region us, validation raises on a duplicate id and on a missing template directory.
acceptance: Selecting a recipe for a Django/React/Postgres/S3 request in region ru returns django-drf-react, and region us raises RegistryError — asserted by the tests.
make demo still completes against the hello-web recipe, so existing projects are unaffected.
constraints: Registry changes are data plus validation code only; do not hardcode recipe ids in the matcher.
Registry JSON stays valid JSON with stable ordering.
plan_goal: Довести проект до выхода на M1 (публичная OSS-альфа): вертикальный срез Django/DRF + React SPA + Postgres + S3 на Yandex Cloud, multi-repo, независимый e2e QA в изолированном стенде, staging с подтверждением человеком, учёт стоимости и приёмок, самохостинг Forgel на самом себе. Первой задачей — проставить в PLAN.md и README отметки о том, что из M0/M0.5 уже сделано, чтобы список отражал реальность.

checks.criterion: Registry validation and selection tests pass
hello-web selection still works for the M0 demo requirements
